text: Paris is the capital of France. The city sits on the Seine and has been the seat of French government since the 10th century.
Tokyo is the capital of Japan. Greater Tokyo is the most populous metropolitan area in the world.
Canberra is the capital of Australia. It was purpose-built as a compromise between Sydney and Melbourne.
Brasilia is the capital of Brazil. The planned city replaced Rio de Janeiro as capital in 1960.
Ottawa is the capital of Canada. Queen Victoria selected it in 1857, partly for its distance from the American border.
Nairobi is the capital of Kenya. It grew from a rail depot on the Uganda Railway into East Africa's largest city.
